text:
emily (Hiring Manager): New hire joining Monday (Kai). I need a very short first-week agenda, a 30/60/90 outline, and a tiny manager "day 1-7" checklist I can paste into the welcome email. Also a one-liner who to ping for common blocks.
sam (People Ops): Copyable one-paragraph plan + bullets incoming. Keeping it short for email. Any special tooling?
emily (Hiring Manager): No GPUs. Repo + staging view + docs-edit. Ship to SF desk.
sam (People Ops): Pasteable first-week agenda:
- Prestart: confirm device delivery, complete payroll & I-9, accept Slack + SSO invites.
- Day 1: 9:30 People Ops intro (benefits/ops), 11:00 manager 1:1 (role & priorities), 2:00 buddy intro, 4:30 team standup + goals.
- Day 2: product walkthrough, repo tour, small starter ticket assigned.
- Day 3: pair on starter ticket, docs PR, security intro (10m).
- Day 4-5: finish starter ticket, cross-team intros, EOW 30m check-in + set 30-day milestone.
EOW deliverable: open PR with a tiny fix and 3-line "what I learned".
Sam (People Ops): Short 30/60/90 bullets (paste-ready):
- 30d: complete onboarding tasks, ship starter PR, attend weekly demos.
- 60d: own a small bug/feature end-to-end, run cross-team syncs.
- 90d: lead a minor improvement, shorten review cycles for own PRs, propose one product tweak.
Sam (People Ops): Manager day1-7 checklist (one-liner bullets):
- Day -1: confirm device + group access, assign buddy.
- Day 1: 11:00 1:1 (expectations, learning plan), intro at standup, lunch with buddy.
- Day 2: show repo + staging, hand off starter task.
- Day 3: pair review + give feedback, unblock access if needed.
- Day 4: check progress, schedule short cross-team intros.
- Day 5: EOW 30min feedback sync, agree 30-day goals.
rachel (IT): Device queued. Imaging Mon 07:30 PT, shipping to SF desk. Groups added: eng, repo-read, docs-edit. Quick CLI if you want to reprovision later: rwctl provision --user kai.j --groups eng,repo-read,docs-edit --device mac-air
devin (Security): Security notes: enable 2FA before infra creds; short intro before granting staging write. KMS/HSM access requires a ticket + manager approval. Link: https://security.redwood/onboard-basics
onboard-bot: New-hire packet assigned to kai.j. Tasks: I-9, payroll, SSO invite. Due: 2026-04-10 17:00 PT.
emily (Hiring Manager): Perfect. Last ask: one-line "who to ping" for the welcome email so the new hire knows where to go for blockers.
sam (People Ops): One-liner (copy): "Who to ping: IT (device/accounts) - @rachel; Security (creds/2FA) - @devin; People Ops (payroll/benefits) - @sam; Buddy/Team questions - assigned by manager."
emily (Hiring Manager): Thanks all — Ill paste this into the welcome email and schedule a Fri "first-week sync". :raised_hands:
